summary.name: Continue
summary.one_liner: Continue is an open-source AI coding agent/assistant that has been acquired by Cursor, with its open-source codebase still freely available.
use_cases: Find an open-source AI coding assistant
Check status of Continue after Cursor acquisition
summary.what_it_does: The page is a notice that Continue has been acquired by Cursor. It states that Continue was an open-source coding agent and that its open-source codebase remains freely available as a foundation for others. The page does not describe current features, supported models, or how to install or use the tool. A directory listing describes Continue as an open-source AI code assistant that works with any LLM.
notable: Acquired by Cursor; the project is no longer independently developed per this page
Described in directory listings as working with any LLM
caveats: Acquired by Cursor; ongoing development and support under Continue's name is not described on the page
Page does not list platforms, features, or current status of the open-source code
